query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS scheduled_at, "$producer" AS lot_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.job_id') AS job_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.delay_seconds') AS INTEGER) AS duration_seconds, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.target_type') AS wakeup_target, 'ACTIVE_QUARANTINE' AS status FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'SystemScheduledEvent' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

fields.name: 🔬 Inbound Potato Batches & Optical Sugar Analysis (C_RS)

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS lot_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.reducing_sugar_index_crs') AS crs_sugar, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.sugar_risk_level') AS risk_level, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.starch_uniformity_score') AS starch_uniformity, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.rationale') AS rationale FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'PotatoOpticalAnalysis' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

view.title: Optical Sugar Index (C_RS) vs CIS Risk Classification

fields.name: ⚡ Modbus PLC Hardware Actuation & Digital Twin Awakening

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.target_device') AS device, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.register_address') AS INTEGER) AS reg_addr, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.written_value') AS written_val, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.status') AS status FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'ModbusStatus' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20
